title: Ghairat Da Na Khuda Sajjad Muhari
body:
Rat Rowanda Raiya, Nalay Sochada Raiya
Phupihyan Day Nangay Sir Haye, Uthon Loug Bazaari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra Diyan Aay Jaiyan, Hath Rasiyan Pakay Aaiyan
Vich Shaam Bazaaran Day Bin Chadaran Toraiyan
Manzar Ay Bhulna Nahi, Haye Abid Nu Zindagi Saari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Watnaan Ton Dur Abid Einj Da Ghareeb Hoiya
Maiyat Bhen Di Loko Bay Kafan Tak Kay Roiya
Kivain Dafan Hai Keeti, Haye Ehnai Behn Vichari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Nu Yaad Aaye Babay Di Badshahi
Jadon Aakhadi Si Logo Haider Di Haan Main Jaye
Ummat Nay Fehr Vi, Haye Vichon Bheer Day Guzaari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Maiyat Hassan Nu Jivain Teeran Day Vich Paroya
Laasha Hassan Day Chan Da Karbal’ch Tukray Hoiya
Pehchandi Keevain, Haye Banaray Nu Maan Vichaari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bharjaiyan Naal Rondi Khari Sain Rasiyan Pakay
Ghazi Nu Wajaan Maray Behna Nu Seenay Lakay
Hoyi Alamaan Walaiya, Haye Sadi Shaam Nu Taiyaari.
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar Di Nojawani Ghazi Day Bazuaan Da
Sadqa Hassan Day Chan Da Farwah Day Aansoan Da
Mola Qabool Kaar, Haye Akhtar Di Pursadaari.
